title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Forwarding the Notice of the Ministry of Land and Resources on Issues Concerning the Mortgage Registration of State-owned Allocated Land Use Rights
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Forwarding the Ministry of Land and Resources' Notice on Issues Concerning the Registration of Mortgage of Allocated State-owned Land Use Rights

Fa Fa [2004] No. 11

To the Higher People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; and the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the Higher People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

The Ministry of Land and Resources issued the Notice on Issues Concerning the Registration of Mortgage of Allocated State-owned Land Use Rights (Guo Tu Zi Fa [2004] No. 9) on January 15, 2004. We hereby forward this Notice to you. For cases involving mortgage of allocated state-owned land use rights that have been lawfully registered with the land administration department having the authority for examination and approval, and which have not yet been finally adjudicated by the people's courts as of the date of issuance of this Notice, the mortgage shall not be deemed invalid on the ground that the mortgage of allocated state-owned land use rights has not been approved. Cases that have already been finally adjudicated shall not be retried on the basis of this Notice.

It is hereby notified.

March 23, 2004

Notice on Issues Concerning the Registration of Mortgage of Allocated State-owned Land Use Rights

Guo Tu Zi Fa [2004] No. 9

To the Departments (Bureaus) of Land and Resources of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government (Departments of Land and Environmental Resources, Bureaus of Land Resources and Housing Management, Bureaus of Housing and Land Administration, Bureaus of Planning and Land Resources):

In accordance with the provisions of relevant national laws and regulations, the following issues concerning the registration of mortgage of allocated state-owned land use rights are hereby notified:

Where the mortgage is established with allocated state-owned land use rights as the subject matter, the land administration department's handling of the mortgage registration procedures in accordance with the law shall be deemed equivalent to having obtained approval from the land administration department with the authority for examination and approval, and there is no need to separately undergo the examination and approval procedures for mortgage of land use rights.

January 15, 2004
